title: Aye momino ye Gham karo
body:
aye momino yeh gham karo
yeh zikr hi paiham karo zehra ki dua lo
aankhon ko zara nam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
aye momino yeh gham karo zehra ki dua lo
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
1. ajati hain jannat se yaha fatima zehra
karti hain yaha milke fughan fatima zehra
hum log kahan aur kahan fatima zehra
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
2. yeh farsh-e-aza arsh-e- mohalla se nahi kam
yeh dil ke dhadakne ki sada kehi hai hardum
taskeen-e-dil-e-fatima zehra hain yahi gham
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
3. is zikr ki azmat se jannat mili humko
is zikr se zehra ki shifa ath mili humko
sadqe mein isi zikr ke jannt mili humko
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
4. har saans pe wajib hai karo zikr yeh paihum
karna na khaza bhool ke mazloom ka matam
khushnudiya allah hai payambar hai yeh gham
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
5. yeh jaan toh abbas ke parcham ke liye hain
roshan hai yeh aankhen toh isi gham ke liye hain
yeh haath salamat hai toh matam ke liye hain
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
6. yeh haath ruke aur na yeh aansoo ke rawani
asghar ki sada yaad rahe tashna dahani
abbas ke bazoo ali akbar ki jawani
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
7. khoon tapkega aankhon se karo yaad wo
manzar
akbar the na qasim the na abbas-e-dilawar
kya alam-e- tanhayi thi zehra ke pisar par
<<MINI>>
mazloom ka matam karo zehra ki dua lo
<<DIVIDER>>
8. is gham ke mitanie ki huwi koshishe paiham
yeh gham na ruka hai na rukega kabhi matam
ooncha hai fareed aaj bhi abbas ka parcham
